overview: A miniseries in four parts about sex and love the first time: Miriam is 16 years old and wants to lose her virginity. The time is now, she thinks. And what's better than finding someone at summer camp? Preferably someone she doesn't need to start a love relationship with. But it doesn't always turn out as planned...
title: Bara sex

overview: In the Persian Empire, King Ahasuerus summons all the virgins of his kingdom in order to choose a new queen. When he meets Esther, the King falls in love with her immediately, without knowing the truth about her origin — she is Jewish.
title: A Historia de Ester

overview: Two contestants attempt to correctly guess words based on definitions given by children ages five to nine.
title: Child's Play

overview: Michael Aspel invites two pairs of contestants made up of members of the public and celebrities to work out what some primary school children are describing.
title: Child's Play

overview: A show in which the hosts analyze the guest's natal chart. Olesya strongly believes in it, and Dima strongly doubts it. The guest decides who is right.
title: Натальная карта

overview: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas takes viewers on a robust and inviting exploration of the Greek landscape, including its people, food, history, traditions, and culture. Diane explores the wondrous world of Greek wines, informing viewers of the country's ancient vinicultural traditions and introducing them to the flavors and varieties that are uniquely Greek.
title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas

overview: Actor and writer Stephen Fry embarks on an exploration of America, a place were he might have been raised, had his father not turned down a job offer from Princeton University. Along this six part journey across all 50 states, Stephen mixes with the locals (both prominent and not) in an attempt to understand the American experience.
title: Stephen Fry in America

overview: An extraordinary story of human survival against the odds. When a Uruguayan rugby team's plane crashed into the Andes Mountains.
title: Alive: The Andes Plane Disaster

overview: These tenacious NYC culture-creators are making money doing what they love. Unscripted. Undaunted. Unleashed. Self-made artists all the way, they prove that confidence in your talent, brand and identity can become a self-fulfilling prophecy.
title: The 212

overview: In southern Africa, risk-taking bush pilots brave rough runways, blazing fires and wild animals.
title: Extreme Airport Africa

overview: Lakis is a hard-working and innocent married man, who hasn't finished high-school because he became a father at a very young age. His father dies and his will determines that, if Lakis is able to finish high school and get into a university, half of his fortune will belong to Lakis and the other half to his already rich brother.
title: Λάκης ο Γλυκούλης

overview: Brazilian comedy about two couples living next to each other in the same building. This show explores the antics between the two couples.
title: Toma Lá, Dá Cá

overview: Epic stories of historical heroes who became legendary with their struggles
title: Tarihin Efsaneleri

overview: Have you ever wondered why the human body looks the way it does? Why our hands have five fingers instead of six? Why we walk on two legs instead of four? It took more than 350 million years for the human body to take shape. How did it become the complicated, quirky, amazing machine it is today? Your Inner Fish delves deep into the past to answer these questions. Anatomist Neil Shubin uncovers the answers in this new look at human evolution. Using fossils, embryos and genes, he reveals how our bodies are the legacy of ancient fish, reptiles and primates — the ancestors you never knew were in your family tree. Premiering Wednesday, April 9, 2014, the three-part series reveals a startling truth: Hidden within the human body is a story of life on Earth.
title: Your Inner Fish

overview: Mist is the leader of the pack working hard every day on Borough Farm in Devon. Join her and the gang Swift, Ernie, Jake, Gail and Fern as they toil through rain and shine to keep all the animals safe on the farm.
title: Mist: Sheepdog Tales

overview: After a birthday banquet, a sudden car accident deals devastating blows to the families of Xiuli and Xiufang. The younger sister Xiuli's second son, Ruoxuan, a high school student with excellent character and grades, loses his young life in a car accident; The older sister Xiufang's only daughter Anxin, a young dance teacher, loses both her legs in the car accident. To help her mother overcome her pain, Xiuli's eldest daughter Ruohua brings Xiuli to her student dormitory. However, Xiuli, who is struggling to heal emotionally, still causes huge trouble to Ruohua, a senior who is about to graduate. Especially in her romantic relationship with Zhou Kaize, Ruohua is tortured due to excessive pressure from her mother; Facing her disheartened daughter Anxin and her increasingly fragile and evasive son-in-law Qin Feng, Xiufang, who has always been obese, is determined to inspire confidence in her daughter by achieving an unprecedented weight-loss success. Ruohua is once paranoid about her relationship with her mother, but they eventually get back on the right track and untie the emotional knot between mother and daughter; Xiufang ultimately succeeds in losing weight and accompanies Anxin as she walks out of her marriage and stand up again to face her life.
title: Born to Run

overview: A comical series that takes place in a camp of the Greek Air Force.
title: Της Ελλάδος ... Τα Παιδιά !!!

overview: The escapades of Zahos Donganos, a single and charming reveler who loves women.
title: Εκείνες & Εγώ

overview: Three sisters Olga, Maria and Irini around at the age of 45. Daughters of a judge, grown in one two-store house that now belongs to the youngest sister, Eirini. When Olga gets married and Maria does the same, they grow apart for about 20 years, until Olga gets widowed and Maria leaves her husband after his adultery. The sisters then, return to their family residence. The name "Harites" was taken partly from ancient Greek mythology (The Three Graces) and partly from their surname, which was "Haritou".
title: Οι Τρεις Χάριτες

overview: Bala, an average IT guy, is forced to host 4 random time travelers who land up in his new house, until they find their way back.
title: Time Enna Boss!?

overview: Meet the Dholakias, a family of four generations living under one roof, as they navigate the ups and downs of their lives. While they appear to be picture perfect, they are endearingly, heartbreakingly human, each with their unique quirks and quibbles. Follow their journey as they try their best to navigate through all the things life throws at them.
title: Happy Family, Conditions Apply

overview: Derek Griffiths narrates an introduction to nature for preschoolers.
title: Animal Antics

overview: Wasted focuses on four mates wasting their twenties in a West Country village. Morpheus, a geeky conspiracy theorist runs a mystical souvenir shop with his unambitious sister, Sarah. His scrounger best friend Kent sleeps on their sofa rent-free, and his secret crush, Alison, runs a new age healing business at the back of the shop.
title: Wasted

overview: Sky News Breakfast starts earlier—and has a fresh new look. Live from 6am every weekday, presenter Gareth Barlow is accompanied by Political Correspondent Mhari Aurora with news from around the world—and around Westminster. Barlow and Aurora stay in studio for Breakfast with Kay Burley from 7am – 10am, when Chief Presenter Kay conducts the morning's biggest interviews. Also joining Sky News Breakfast will be Wilfred Frost with previews of the day's news agenda live from the main newsroom.
title: Breakfast with Kay Burley

overview: Divorce doesn't have to spell disaster. Even with alternating care, it can be fun. Especially when such quirky characters as ours are involved. Sure, even in Jedna rodina, things get rough sometimes, but love always wins in the end. Because more parents mean more love.
title: Jedna rodina

overview: Candace takes you through her journey as a curious mother to question the mainstream narrative surrounding childhood vaccines, corruption in the food industry, and the exploitation of kids on social media. Through her own experiences, Candace hopes to inspire you to embark on your own paths of discovery and decision-making.
title: A Shot in the Dark

overview: Based on the New York Times bestselling book, A History of the World in Six Glasses takes us on a tour around the world to taste the drinks that changed history. Star Dan Aykroyd hosts fellow Saturday Night Live alums Jim Belushi, Jon Lovitz, and Kevin Nealon along with Cheers stalwart George Wendt as they discuss beer, wine, coffee, tea, soda, and spirits.
title: A History of the World in Six Glasses

overview: Featuring interviews with his followers, critics and Raël himself, this docuseries traces how a UFO-inspired religion spiraled into a controversial cult.
title: Raël: The Last Prophet

overview: Rise of the Witches, set in ancient Arabia, tells the story of an epic war between two rival witch covens, led by Afsaar and Da'ja'a. Growing up in a world dominated by male magicians who want to prevent women from having any access to magical powers, both witches secretly learn the arts and go on to form their own groups in order to protect themselves and gain power.
title: Rise of the Witches

overview: Chilling series about prisoners serving life sentences who continue to offend inside.
title: World's Most Dangerous Prisoners

overview: Based on the multi-Eisner Award-winning graphic novel series created by Ed Brubaker and Sean Phillips, Criminal tells the interweaving saga of several generations of families tied together by the crimes and murders of the past.
title: Criminal

overview: Based on the true events of the battle of Songmaoling in 1934, the drama follows the determination of young soldiers as they defend Songmaoling for seven days and nights.
title: Xue Zhan Song Mao Ling

overview: Gareth Blackstock (Lenny Henry) is a master chef with an obsessive drive for culinary perfection, with no friends or outside interests other than his wife Janice, (Caroline Lee-Johnson) and remarkable verbal talents used primarily to creatively abuse his unfortunate staff of assistant cooks, although he is perfectly prepared to give the same treatment to waiters, management, suppliers, bankers, and, occasionally, customers.
title: Chef!

overview: What could our world have been like if Peter the Great had opened a window to the marketplace, Catherine II had chosen her favorites in a mobile app, and Ivan the Terrible had undergone online therapy with a psychologist? In each story, the bygone days of different historical figures and modern technologies of our days are intertwined.
title: Смешная история

overview: Yan Zhen married into the Anshi Group as a young lady, but found herself widowed within a year when her husband mysteriously disappeared on their wedding anniversary. Four years later, Yan Zhen has become a determined assistant manager of the company, ready to declare her husband dead when she suddenly comes across his "return". The man in front of her is identical in appearance to her husband, but his personality has changed drastically, claiming to be her brother-in-law. This man is constantly against Yan Zhen, believing that she was the mastermind behind the accident that happened years ago, while Yan Zhen really seems to be hiding a secret.
title: All of Her

overview: Couple to Throuple follows four curious couples through the world of polyamory as they experiment with bringing a third partner into their relationship. Set at a remote tropical resort, the couples will meet, mingle, and date a group of singles, many of whom are experienced in polyamory. With three times the fun, the feelings, and drama, these relationships are put through the ultimate test to see if they are the perfect match. At the end of their time in paradise, the couples will decide if their hearts have room for more than just "the one" and commit as a throuple, go home as they arrived, or leave separately.
title: Couple to Throuple

overview: A young man who leaves behind the woman he loves and his family to join the military. Upon his return, he faces unexpected events that transform him into a cruel man.
title: Gaddar

overview: The decades-long friendship between three married couples is tested when one divorces, complicating their tradition of quarterly weekend getaways.
title: The Four Seasons

overview: Peter Kosminsky's BAFTA award winning drama about a British Muslim family who are pulled in radically different directions by their conflicting personal experiences in post 9/11 Britain.
title: Britz

overview: All new series where Alexis and his team of experts tackle the problems affecting you the most.
title: Alexis Conran & Friends

overview: Ear to the Ground, RTÉ's longest running factual series offers a fresh, new look at how rural Ireland is changing.
title: Ear to the Ground

overview: Comprehensive coverage of local, national and international news. Plus, all the latest sport and weather.
title: 10 News First: Midday

overview: The latest in local news, weather, traffic, celebrity interviews and lifestyle trends.
title: Breakfast Television

overview: Award-winning anchor Sandie Rinaldo leads a new early evening edition of CTV National News.
title: CTV National News with Sandie Rinaldo

overview: Join the News First team for all the day's current events, sports, and weather.
title: News First on Sky Open

overview: The provincial distillery was "transferred" to the new Moscow owners. An ambitious young Vladimir took the place of the old director of the LVZ, who was imprisoned under house arrest. On the very first day, he sets his own rules and gets rid of everything old. Namely, he fires the old secretary Dina, who was the soul of the team, the audacious assembly line technician Ira and the young technologist Tatiana, who is too demanding of quality standards. Desperate to find another job in their town, these three women, thrown out of their native factory, decide to make... their own.
title: Повышая градус

overview: Lifetime's explosive docuseries Prison Brides follows seven women from around the world who believe they have found their soulmates in the most unexpected of places, American prisons. While they started off as prison pen pals, these women fell hard and found themselves willing to risk it all for love. The docuseries follows the women as they travel from their homes—many visiting the United States for the first time—to meet their prisoner fiancés, husbands, or partners, to chart their futures together. With the couples facing harsh judgment from friends, family and strangers, the brides grapple with uncertainty and their ultimate decision to risk it all for true love. Will true love prevail for these star-crossed lovers with the odds stacked against them?
title: Prison Brides

overview: The Odd Couple features endearing slob Oscar Madison and uptight neat freak Felix Unger, two former college buddies who become unlikely roommates after the demise of their marriages. It's not long after Oscar lets Felix move in that Oscar fears he's made a monumental mistake. However, despite how exasperated they make each other, these mismatched friends agree they can help each other move on from their divorces and somehow make their crazy living arrangement work.
title: The Odd Couple

overview: When a detective's maverick approach to investigating gets him suspended, he teams with a journalist to solve a series of brutal murders outside the law.
title: Forst

overview: Fueled by passion and NASCAR Cup glory, drivers and their teams compete for the championship and the chance to make history in this sports docuseries.
title: NASCAR: Full Speed

overview: After getting kicked out of his own company, a hapless man must juggle his delicate marriage and his struggling comedy club.
title: Komedi Kacau

overview: The Silent Service depicts Kaieda's story on a grand scale, from declaring the independent state of Yamato and negotiating a military alliance with Japan, to the subsequent Battle of Tokyo Bay. Drama uses same cast and crew that worked on theatrical movie released a year earlier, and first four episodes are basically re-shoots of the movie, and then expand on that story.
title: Chinmoku no Kantai: Tokyo Wan Daikaisen

overview: Russell Peters teams up with some of the most irresponsible comedians in the business for a season of edgy and irreverent stand-up.
title: Russell Peters: Irresponsible Ensemble

overview: The latest celebrity gossip, opinions, Hollywood happenings, and the day's big news.
title: Access Daily with Mario & Kit

overview: Join Harvey Levin, Charles Latibeaudiere and the rest of the TMZ staff as hot topics and breaking news are presented.
title: TMZ Live

overview: Emmy®-nominated and eminently stylish, Judge Kevin Ross dishes out justice with a wink and a smile. He's a former L.A. Superior Court judge with over 60,000 cases under his belt, and he uses his razor wit to challenge assumptions and question the answers. Justice has never looked or sounded sharper than America's Court with Judge Ross.
title: America's Court with Judge Ross

overview: In Cutlers Court, Judges Dana and Keith Cutler hear from a large assortment of couples who are having difficulty in their relationships. Cheating, paternity, money, whatever the disagreement, it has come to a boiling point, and the ultimate decision for the Cutlers to make in every episode is: should the relationship continue, or should they call it quits?
title: Cutlers Court

overview: Divorce Court began as a dramatized court show in 1957, but later and presently is an arbitration-based reality court show. The program is nontraditional within the judicial genre as it mostly resolves the disputes of couples facing the end of their relationship. It has been presided over by many television personalities: former Cleveland Heights Municipal Court Judge Lynn Toler and Judge Mablean Ephraim, Judge Faith Jenkins, and currently Judge Star Jones. Divorce Court is produced by Lincolnwood Drive, Inc. and distributed by Fox First Run.
title: Divorce Court

overview: Stella, a comedic satire of everyday life. Don't let the suits fool you…the maturity level of these guys doesn't always match their attire. As they go through their day they spread their sarcasm and wit-tinged non-sensical comedy to everyone they meet.
title: Stella

overview: Distinguished author and three-time Emmy® winner Judge Cristina Perez puts the flair in fair in this courtroom series. Her hip and fresh perspective, combined with her warm and personal approach, appeals to all ages — as well as Television Academy voters. Justice for All with Judge Cristina Perez was nominated for a best court program Emmy® Award and backboarded the launch of two accredited novels and a growing fanbase.
title: Justice for All with Cristina Perez

overview: Best known for her sassy personality and bold judgments, Judge Karen Mills-Francis is now presiding over Supreme Justice with Judge Karen. Judge Karen boasts over 13 years of legal experience and is a successful published author. As a seasoned legal veteran of the courtroom, Judge Karen isn't afraid to put litigants in their place. She's quick to protect the unprotected and rationalize the irrational, all while using her quick wit to break the tension. Judge Karen's captivating style and unwavering dedication to justice makes "Supreme Justice with Judge Karen" a must-see.
title: Supreme Justice with Judge Karen

overview: Two-time Emmy-nominated Judge Glenda Hatchett stars in The Verdict with Judge Hatchett, on JusticeCentral.TV.
title: The Verdict with Judge Hatchett

overview: The drama series "Story of Kunning Palace" is planning a team-building trip in Sanya for three days and two nights with eight of its main cast members. They will not only experience pirate-themed activities but also take on various game tasks combined with the plot. The loser of each game will receive a punishment written by the female lead's "magical pen." Finally, they will hold a themed concert for the audience.
title: As You Wish: Story of Kunning Palace

overview: In this digital exclusive, Helen Bauer invites the As Yet Untitled guests to pull up a stool in her backstage bar for a pre-show tipple.
title: As Yet Untitled: Bauer's Bar

overview: An in-depth look at the whistleblowers who sparked a UFO revolution, revealing evidence that the government knows much more than they're letting on.
title: TMZ Presents: UFO Revolution

overview: A Prisoner's Path is a docuseries that takes on the important task of criminal justice reform in prisons across America. Focusing on trauma and substance abuse recovery programs, inmates are provided opportunities that they never had access to before.
title: A Prisoner's Path

overview: After a break-up, Ada has to get used to single life in the old collective. Romantic comedy drama about how friends mess up with – and mess up for – each other.
title: Fling

overview: When one accidental killing leads to another, an average college student finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.
title: A Killer Paradox

overview: Max and Scratch, two lovable tiger cubs, jump aboard the Animal Express train to go in search of the world's wildest animals in this introductory wildlife programme for younger viewers. Part live action, part animation.
title: Animal Express

overview: A roundup of all the fun things happening at Milkshake!
title: Milkshake! News

overview: Wish You Were Here...? is a British television series that was first broadcast on 7 January 1974 on ITV. It was a series of 30-minute shows about travel and holidays. The show was broadcast during peak viewing hours. The series was cancelled in 2003 after a reshuffling of the primetime Monday 7pm slot on ITV.
title: Wish You Were Here...?

overview: Mark Millar helps homeowners to transform the most important rooms in the house.
title: Your Dream Kitchen for Less

overview: The World with Yalda Hakim will discuss the latest international news headlines and hear from the big names shaping the global outlook. Yalda will interview leaders and news makers, holding some of the world's most powerful to account. Each evening, a special guest panel will join Yalda live in the studio for conversation and analysis that explores the issues defining our times. The show will become the home for Sky News' international reporting and will showcase eyewitness journalism from Sky's award-winning foreign reporting team led by Special Correspondent and BAFTA award-winner, Alex Crawford, and Chief Correspondent and International Emmy award-winner, Stuart Ramsay.
title: The World with Yalda Hakim

overview: Bonnie is a family comedy about a former backup singer who left the grind of touring fifteen years ago to live on the rez, help raise her brother's kids and live her dream of being "Cool Auntie."
title: Bonnie

overview: De Biker Boys is a comical mockumentary, broadcast from 2014 by the Belgian public broadcasting company Eén and produced by Koeken Troef.
title: De Biker Boys

overview: Margot Fonteyn explores her own world of dance - from the dominance of the ballerina in the 1930s to the emergence of the great male dancers - in a series from 1979.
title: The Magic of Dance

overview: The story follows the female author Hua Qingge as she unexpectedly enters the world of her own novel, taking on the role of a supporting character destined for failure. Armed with the script, she anticipates turning the tide, but instead, her journey takes a series of unexpected turns as she becomes entangled in a tale of love and hate with Ji Chu.
title: Different Princess

overview: This is a film series that inspires hope. It shows the destruction we have caused in our waters, but also that it is possible to repair the damage we have caused. Over the course of three years, documentary filmmaker Martin Falklind and his team make a magical journey through Swedish rivers, lakes and seas, to an underwater world that most of us barely knew existed. In the series, we will see how we have fished out many of our waters, with collapsed ecosystems as a result. But we also get to see good and concrete examples that clearly show that it is possible to repair the damage and that it is possible to reverse the development for the better.
title: Fiskarnas rike

overview: Be transported to the early American West! In 1822, Jim Bridger embarked on history-making escapades as a mountain man, explorer, trapper, and Cavalry Scout. Join Bridger on his later travels as a Bozeman Trail guide to settlers, soldiers, speculators, and other colorful characters, many who had no idea of the dangerous challenges they would face. Bridger shares his wisdom through incredible, heart-racing tales of his death-defying adventures on the Western Frontier. Every week brings a new group of travelers and another of Bridger's heroic stories of justice, pivotal life-changing choices, daring escapes, fights waged against all odds, and much more. Just how tall are these tall tales? Mere exaggeration or the whole truth? You be the judge!
title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger

overview: Tomo is a shy young man, pathologically nervous in the company of young women, who can trace this condition back to the childhood bullying he received at the hands of his cousin Ikuko. But when his parents go abroad for along trip, the fearful Tomo is forced to move in with his relatives, only to discover that the horrible Ikuko has grown into a beautiful young woman.
title: Sankaku Heart

overview: This series delves into the lives and psyches of women who have committed irreparable acts. Each episode tells the story of a murderess who has made the headlines, and traces the thread of a tragedy that has left an indelible mark. Through these deeply moving stories, we revisit the places, times and social context that led to the tragedy.
title: Elles ont tué

overview: As an unknown virus spreads throughout the city, transforming the population into zombies, a group of students take refuge in a school to defend themselves against the outside threat. Their escape becomes a race against time to leave without being contaminated.
title: Zomvivor

overview: The story unfolds from a mysterious sheepskin scroll as a group of heroes go through the twists and turns of fate, confronting the choice of love and hate and finally realizing their ambition to serve their country.
title: Hero Legends

overview: A new six-part series that takes us behind the scenes of an iconic Irish brand, Penneys. The series starts where it all began, the Penneys OG on Mary's Street.
title: Inside Penneys
